questions.question: Ssenariy: klasterda container escape hujumi. Defense in depth blast radius'ni qanday cheklaydi?
questions.explanation: Non-root (runAsNonRoot: true): hujumchi host'ga imtiyozsiz user sifatida tushadi (user namespace bilan yanada yaxshi).

questions.question: Ssenariy: SLSA Level 3 ga mos avtomatik end-to-end supply chain xavfsizlik pipeline'ini loyihalang.
Ssenariy: hardcode DB parolli legacy ilovani Vault dynamic secrets'ga downtime'siz qanday ko'chirasiz?
questions.explanation: ESO yoki Vault Agent sidecar — credential'larni in-memory volume'ga (/vault/secrets/database.env).

questions.question: TCP SYN flood'ni kernel va load balancer darajasida qanday kamaytirasiz?
Kubernetes'da Cilium va WireGuard bilan zero-trust microsegmentation qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Cilium eBPF: pod'larni o'zgartirmasdan L3–L7 NetworkPolicy.

questions.question: Ssenariy: auditda muhandislarning prod EC2'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri SSH kirishi aniqlandi. Teleport yoki SSM bilan zero-trust access gateway qanday joriy qilasiz?
questions.explanation: portga ruxsat beruvchi SG qoidalarini o'chirish; public IP'larni olib tashlash.

questions.question: Secrets sprawl nima va enterprise tuzatish pipeline'ini qanday loyihalaysiz?
questions.explanation: Secret'lar kod, config, chat, CI o'zgaruvchilari bo'ylab tarqalib ketishi.

questions.question: DNS tunneling / exfiltration nima va qanday bloklanadi?
questions.explanation: Hujum: zararli dastur o'g'irlangan ma'lumotni DNS subdomen'larga kodlab (data.evil-domain.com) hujumchining authoritative serveriga so'raydi — HTTP filtrlarini chetlab o'tadi.

questions.question: Ssenariy: turli AWS VPC'lardagi ikki Kubernetes klasterini public internetsiz xavfsiz qanday ulaysiz?
questions.explanation: VPC'larni Transit Gateway yoki VPC peering bilan ulash (CIDR'lar kesishmasin, pod CIDR'lar ham).

questions.question: Pod Security Standards (Privileged, Baseline, Restricted) farqi.
questions.explanation: Privileged: cheklovsiz — privileged container, host network, hostPath.
